note: The query that shows Postgres ready no longer selects a constant: it asks the server which database answered (its cluster identifier and the database's oid), and the run goes on to a migration that is allowed only on that database. One block is rewritten, the first listed: it pins the query's text in the list of Docker calls. The other six are byte for byte the same at the head; they are listed because the base file fails on them too, as it does on every run that reaches the end of the sequence: the base's stand-in for Docker answers the query with nothing, where the command now needs the database's identity before it migrates. At the head the stand-in answers it and all seven pass. That result of the clean runs alone gives the verdict. The suite runs the command as a child process, which this tool's in-memory mutation does not reach, so the search and replace of this case are never applied; the mutations of the command were run against a mutated clone with the suite pointed at it, and the pull request lists them.
